item.title: Mission to save Swift spacecraft fails, will crash back to Earth
item.description:

item.title: Cities are getting hotter: 'Thermal Justice' offers a fairer way to adapt
item.description:
Waypoint is curating and commenting on third-party reporting. Original publisher: Phys.org.
Summary: When temperatures rise, public advice is familiar: drink water, avoid strenuous activity during the hottest hours, keep homes cool and check on older or isolated people. These recommendations are reflected in the latest heat-health guidance from the WHO Regional Office for Europe.
Waypoint’s Take: An outdoor reader can treat this as field context — ask what the camera clarifies that a walk alone might miss. Keep the publisher’s claims provisional until you read the original. If you photograph related subjects, keep one technique question for a quiet Scenes review afterward.
